item.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike taken to hospital after surviving two lethal injections, says lawyer
item.description: One of her attorneys told the BBC that Pike, 50, was in hospital after two syringes of pentobarbital had been administered.

item.title: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger
item.description: An aeroplane flying to Israel fell 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes before it was diverted.

item.title: Too early to say what motive for Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack was, Israeli PM says
